objective: Evaluate intervention decisions, prospective abstention, and independent human fallback across a bounded set of source-verified randomized experiments.
claim_scope: initial multi-experiment benchmark; trust prediction is exploratory

split_strategy.prospective_method: one frozen six-experiment evaluation after every model, diagnostic, fallback, and reporting decision is committed
split_strategy.reason: With fifteen experiments, a nominal three-way split would make validation and test inference too unstable. Development uses grouped resampling while six paradigm-disjoint experiments remain prospective.

corpus_gates.stop_now: Do not search a new external corpus while the fifteen-task scope remains achievable from already-audited candidates.
corpus_gates.pivot_if: Fewer than fifteen independent, paradigm-valid tasks remain after the cap, one batch yields zero runnable contracts, or two consecutive replacement candidates fail for the same structural reason.
corpus_gates.pivot_to: Freeze the smaller corpus, narrow the claim, and move effort to simulator and fallback depth; do not restore ambiguous tasks.

simulator_gates.prune_if: A configuration breaches its cost cap, has parse success below 0.98, or adds no distinct decision-level hypothesis beyond a cheaper configuration.
simulator_gates.fine_tuning_gate: No LoRA run unless the prompted suite is complete and a specific development result predicts a decision-level benefit.

trust_gates.validation: nested leave-one-paradigm-out on development tasks; one frozen policy on the prospective tasks
trust_gates.pivot_if: The frozen diagnostic policy fails to improve both risk-coverage area and regret at a prespecified coverage over random abstention in development resampling.
trust_gates.pivot_to: Report confident failure as a negative result and use a conservative human-validation policy instead of fitting more diagnostics.

fallback_gates.evaluation: pilot participants are disjoint from evaluation participants in every replicate
fallback_gates.pivot_if: The synthetic-informed policy fails to reduce development regret relative to human-only or uniform validation at every nonzero budget.
fallback_gates.pivot_to: Preserve the negative result and report the human-only cost curve as the operational fallback.

abort_conditions: projected run cost exceeds its frozen ceiling
model outputs fail the parser gate
the run duplicates a cheaper configuration without a new hypothesis
